# fixture bell buoy

| Field  | Value                |
| ------ | -------------------- |
| Issue  | re-cinq/bowman-ui#17 |
| Status | Shipped              |

The bell buoy off the sand bar is lifted every spring so the chain can be shortened against
the year's scour.

## The rule

- The bell is swung by hand before the buoy goes back on station
  ([validated by](../../__tests__/fixture-evidence.ts#L9999)).
- A shortened chain is logged against the buoy's own number, never the station's.
